label: collisions checked per input, not up front
find: try refuseCollisions(plan.items, force: force, io: io)

label: a pattern matching nothing is an empty run
find: guard !matches.isEmpty else { throw .data("input \(pattern) matches no file") }

label: step ids not checked before the run
find: if let bad = steps.first(where: { !ids.contains($0.id) }) { throw .usage("unknown command \(bad.id) in \(app)") }

label: {index} not zero-padded
find: let padded = String(repeating: "0", count: max(0, width - number.count)) + number
